fixed_recipe: tree-regularized consensus + six label-free slate count/diversity corrections + broad/conditional content graph smoothing + temporal slate corrections + three Bayesian-smoothed training-only cross-conditional priors
selection_evidence: All seventeen sequential corrections improved cross-fitted primary on disjoint user folds. The final nine conditional, temporal, and training-prior terms retained the same selected sign on all four user-id-modulo folds.
leakage_note: The content/temporal correction is transductive but label-free: it uses the complete supplied evaluation impression slate and static video metadata, matching the official batch evaluator. The final three priors use outcomes only from the April 8-21 training block. No validation long_view, click, play time, or other outcome is read as a feature. Deployments that do not know the complete candidate slate must not use the transductive terms as written.
rejected_ablations: Monte Carlo dropout LCB: fold correction signs disagreed and OOF primary regressed.

Synthetic-exposure density weighting: square-root OOF primary was 0.611053 and full weighting was 0.6109525.
Video-type slate concentration: fixed score improved but cross-fitted primary regressed, so it was excluded.
